decision.summary: The exact frozen P0 run completed once, but the pre-registered source gate failed: 23/94 events, 18/37 delivery clusters, and 8/9 frozen months were eligible. 125 of 126 registered-snapshot errors were CONTRACT_ZERO_ACTIVITY; one was Bybit retCode 10016. Metrics from the surviving subset are descriptive only and cannot support the registered mechanism inference.
allowed_claims: The exact frozen full P0 run completed once with exit code 0
23 of 94 events were eligible under the frozen source-integrity rule
8 of 9 frozen months had an eligible cluster
No alternate source or source substitution was used
forbidden_reuse: Do not treat the surviving 18 clusters as a replacement valid experiment
Do not promote descriptive metrics to a terminal mechanism verdict
Do not relax the zero-activity eligibility rule and rerun on the same outcomes
Do not substitute alternate price sources
Do not search alternate horizons, symbols or thresholds from these outcomes
decision.next_allowed_action: Review official Bybit source coverage semantics without source substitution or outcome-based rescue; if a successor is defensible, pre-register it before new outcome access.
